tools.name: calculate_loan_emi

tools.name: project_sip
tools.description: Projected value of a monthly SIP (systematic investment plan) in mutual funds, optionally increased every year (step-up). Assumes the investment is made at the start of each month and compounds monthly at the expected return. Returns are not guaranteed.

tools.name: calculate_fd_maturity
tools.description: Maturity value and interest on a bank fixed deposit in India, compounded quarterly, before tax.

tools.name: calculate_xirr

tools.name: plan_fd_ladder
tools.description: Maturity of a set of fixed deposits with different amounts, tenures and rates (an FD ladder), as Indian banks pay it: simple interest under 6 months, compounded quarterly from 6 months. tools.name: home_loan_affordability
tools.description: Largest home loan a monthly take-home pay supports, the way Indian banks work it out: all EMIs together within a share of take-home pay (FOIR, default 50%), and RBI's loan-to-value limits (90% of the home's value up to Rs 30 lakh, 80% up to Rs 75 lakh, 75% above). tools.name: calculate_salary_in_hand
tools.description: Monthly and yearly in-hand salary from an annual CTC in India under the new tax regime (FY 2026-27). Assumes employee and employer PF at 12% of basic capped at Rs 1,800 a month, gratuity at 4.81% of basic, and professional tax of Rs 200 a month. Variable pay is shown separately after its own tax.
